system.description: These three-inch spheres of jade and adamant have five gimbaled concentric rings on their exterior that each rotate in separate directions. Attuning one of these devices requires a commitment of two motes (regardless of the owner's Exalt type). While holding the device, an attuned owner sees a glowing thread of light leading from it to the exact geomantic center of the nearest manse. However, if the owner presses the correct series of pressure plates on the compass, it unfolds to reveal a small compartment. (Puzzling out the device's function requires a successful [Intelligence + Lore] roll, difficulty 1, if the user is unaware of it.) If a hearthstone is placed within this compartment, the device closes, and the thread of light instead points to the center of the manse that created the stone. Treasure hunters often make use of this feature to locate abandoned or ownerless manses through their "useless" hearthstones. These artifacts function only in Creation, though the dead have their own variants for locating inauspicious manses raised in the Underworld.
